description:
Высокопроизводительный движок системного уровня для записи, редактирования и воспроизведения клавиатурных макросов.
Включает безопасную запись, редактор событий, собственные сочетания клавиш и настраиваемую скорость воспроизведения.

Это дополнение основано на NVDA Macro Manager от Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. Оно публикуется как отдельное дополнение, чтобы разработку можно было продолжать активно.
changelog:
1.0.1

Fixed chords being flattened. When two keys overlapped, the release of the first was injected in the same
system call as the press of the second, so the two were never held down at the same moment and the target
application saw two unrelated keystrokes instead of the combination. Presses now only ever travel with
presses and releases with releases.
Raising the playback speed no longer shrinks the overlap between two keys to nothing; keys held together
now stay together for at least the configured minimum hold time.

1.0

First release of Macro Studio.

Macro Studio continues the work of NVDA Macro Manager by Muhammet Enes Şenovalı as a separate add-on, so that
development can carry on actively. The keyboard engine of the original add-on was rewritten and a large number
of defects were fixed before this release.

Playback engine:
Keys that were pressed together are now replayed together. A whole chord is injected with a single system call
instead of one key after another, and overlapping or held keys keep their original order and timing.
Keys chosen from the key list now carry their real scan code and extended flag, so arrows, Insert, Delete,
Home, End, right Ctrl, right Alt and numpad divide no longer arrive as a different key.
Fixed the key list replacing standard letters with layout specific keys, which could send a completely
different key than the one selected.
Fixed partially rejected keystroke batches being resent in full, which produced duplicate keystrokes.
Fixed a race that allowed the same macro to start twice and interleave its keystrokes.
Fixed a hold time floor that was applied to every key release and pulled apart keys released together.
Fixed the application lock being bypassed when the foreground application could not be identified.

Recording:
Fixed a recording that repeated a single key being erased by the stop hotkey trimming.
Fixed key events that are not real key transitions being stored and then silently dropped on playback.
Recording can no longer be started while a macro is playing, and a failed keyboard hook is now reported.

Macros and interface:
Fixed macros saved from the dialog being locked to NVDA itself instead of the target application.
Fixed the smart loop optimiser dropping most repetitions of macros with a loop count above one.
Fixed duplicated macros sharing an identifier, which made one of them impossible to assign a gesture to.
Fixed the macro list keeping a hidden extra selection, so deleting could remove the wrong macro.
Fixed hold-to-run, which failed on every hotkey and could stop itself on its own keystrokes.
Fixed an empty playback speed field aborting the save.
Fixed all playback messages failing silently because a loop variable shadowed the translation function.
Export file names are now sanitised and the clipboard import is size limited.
The dark dialog colours are only applied when Windows itself is in dark mode.
Keyboard hooks are released when the add-on is unloaded.

Translations:
Complete translations for Arabic, Azerbaijani, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Dutch, English, Filipino,
German, Hindi, Kurdish (Kurmanji and Sorani), Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Spanish, Turkish and
Vietnamese. The German and Spanish catalogues of the original add-on were keyed to obsolete source strings and
never actually applied.
